requirementSegments: Create a compute entity that produces a register status report

It has exactly one required string input named status. Its binding source is contextdb, its subject is speaker, and its property is register_status. Preserve the identifiers status, speaker, and register_status exactly. Do not add current to the property name. Do not ask the user for status
When I ask Give me the register status report, return The current register status is followed by the status

steps.name: report open status
steps.input: Give me the register status report

expect.answer: The current register status is open.

steps.name: report closed status
steps.input: Give me the register status report

expect.answer: The current register status is closed.
